result.instructions: Tools for Lithic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our cards are paused right now, and who holds them?"; "Show the declined transactions from the last 7 days and their merchants."; "Pause the card ending in 4242 until we finish the fraud review.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lithic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run lithic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lithic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lithic_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. lithic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lithic_list_cards
tools.title: List cards
tools.description: List cards with their state (OPEN, PAUSED, CLOSED, PENDING_ACTIVATION, PENDING_FULFILLMENT), memo, and spend limit. Non-PCI fields only: no card number or CVV. Lithic API: GET /v1/cards.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the token of the last item on the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor: the token of the first item on the next page.

tools.name: lithic_get_card
tools.title: Get a card
tools.description: Get one card by token: state, memo, spend limit, type, and last four digits. Non-PCI fields only. Lithic API: GET /v1/cards/{card_token}.

tools.name: lithic_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List card transactions with status (PENDING, SETTLED, VOIDED, DECLINED, EXPIRED), result (APPROVED or DECLINED), amount, and merchant. Lithic API: GET /v1/transactions.

tools.name: lithic_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction by token, including its events (authorization, clearing, return) and merchant details. Lithic API: GET /v1/transactions/{transaction_token}.

tools.name: lithic_list_account_holders

tools.name: lithic_get_account_holder
tools.title: Get an account holder
tools.description: Get one account holder by token, including KYC/KYB status and enrollment details. Lithic API: GET /v1/account_holders/{account_holder_token}.

account_holder_token.description: The account holder token (UUID) from lithic_list_account_holders.

tools.name: lithic_list_financial_accounts
tools.title: List financial accounts
tools.description: List financial accounts (ISSUING, OPERATING, RESERVE, SECURITY) with their status and balance settings. Lithic API: GET /v1/financial_accounts.

tools.name: lithic_get_financial_account
tools.title: Get a financial account
tools.description: Get one financial account by token. Lithic API: GET /v1/financial_accounts/{financial_account_token}.

financial_account_token.description: The financial account token (UUID) from lithic_list_financial_accounts.

tools.name: lithic_pause_card
tools.title: Pause a card
tools.description: Pause a card so it declines new transactions. Reversible with lithic_unpause_card. Does not close the card. Lithic API: PATCH /v1/cards/{card_token} with state PAUSED.

tools.name: lithic_unpause_card
tools.title: Unpause a card
tools.description: Set a paused card back to OPEN so it accepts transactions again. Lithic API: PATCH /v1/cards/{card_token} with state OPEN.
